name: Lewisporte
text: Lewisporte is a town in central Newfoundland, Canada, with a population of 3,288. It is situated in Burnt Bay which opens on to the Bay of Exploits. Lewisporte has a deep water port and related facilities that serve many communities in the region.

depictions.name: Lewisporte
depictions.text: Lewisporte is a town in central Newfoundland Island, Canada. During the mid-18th century, a sizable outpost occupied by French forces was located in an area near the coast, which was largely covered with ice sheets. Enclosed by a palisade wall, the settlement consisted of a mining shaft and a small grouping of buildings, some of which were used to stock various supplies.
